synthesis:draft.headline: Operational demand is the region-level demand met by scheduled, semi‑scheduled, significant non‑scheduled and interconnector imports, excluding certain local scheduled loads and including Wholesale Demand Response.

document_statements.quote: Operational demand in a region is demand that is met by local scheduled 6, semi-scheduled7 and significant non-scheduled generation, by generation from scheduled bidirectional units, and by generation imports to the region, excluding the demand of local scheduled loads10 and scheduled bidirectional units, and including Wholesale Demand Response.

Operational demand differs from native demand in that it generally excludes demand met by non- scheduled wind/solar generation of aggregate capacity < 30 MW, non-scheduled non-wind/non-solar generation and exempt generation.
Actual operational demand includes the measured operational demand reconstituted with estimated actual WDR.
OPERATIONAL_DEMAND Average 30-minute measured operational demand MW value (unadjusted and not reconstituted with estimated actual WDR).
WDR_ESTIMATE Estimated average 30-minute MW amount of Wholesale Demand Response that occurred.

Forecast operational demand less SNSG is used in Pre-dispatch14, Pre-dispatch Projected Assessment of System Adequacy (PDPASA15), Short Term Projected Assessment of System Adequacy (STPASA 16) and Medium Term Projected Assessment of System Adequacy (MTPASA) processes (discussed in Section 2.1.2 under Total Demand in Pre-dispatch, Section 2.2.1 for PDPASA and STPASA and Section 2.2.2 for MTPASA).
